auth.token_lifetime: Offline tokens persist across sessions; online tokens last as long as the staff session
auth.refresh: Offline access token reused; no refresh needed for classic offline tokens (expiring offline tokens UNVERIFIED)

access_requirements.partner_program_name: Shopify Partner Program (free Partner account needed to create public apps)
access_requirements.app_review_or_marketplace_listing: Public apps must pass protected-customer-data review: Level 1 requires review; Level 2 (name, address, phone, email) requires review plus data protection reviews. Custom apps bypass it.
access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Option A (custom per-store app): store admin creates a custom app in Settings > Apps > Develop apps, selects read scopes, installs, and gives us the Admin API token. Option B (public/unlisted distribution): merchant clicks install link and approves scopes.
access_requirements.cost_to_us: $0 for Partner account; app submission free (UNVERIFIED for fees)

sandbox.how_to_get: Partner dashboard > Stores > create development store (free, self-serve)

rate_limits: UNVERIFIED (not fetched; Shopify GraphQL uses calculated query cost buckets)
incremental_sync: GraphQL query filter updated_at:>=ISO with cursor pagination; Bulk Operations API for backfill; webhooks for deltas

unified_api_coverage.apideck: unverified (name appears on connectors page, not confirmed as connector)

blockers: Public app route needs protected customer data approval (Level 2 for customer PII) before arbitrary merchants can install.
Interim path: merchant-created custom app token avoids review but needs manual admin steps per store.
sources: https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/authentication-authorization - custom apps use client credentials grant, no merchant approval; public apps cannot
https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/launch/protected-customer-data - table: Public Level 1 'Requires review', Level 2 'Requires review + data protection reviews'; Custom 'Always available'
